Test Steps: Verify Admin can generate Attendance Report
Test Data: 1. Log in as Admin 2. Go to Reports 3. Select 'Attendance Report' 4. Pick Date Range (Last Month) 5. Generate
Date of execution: System fetches data and displays a tabular report of employee attendance.

Test Steps: Verify Admin can generate Payroll Summary Report
Test Data: 1. Select 'Payroll Summary' 2. Pick Month (e.g., January) 3. Generate
Date of execution: System displays aggregated salary disbursed data for the selected month.

Test Steps: Verify validation when generating report for future dates
Test Data: 1. Select 'Attendance Report' 2. Select Date Range in the future (Next Month) 3. Generate
Date of execution: System shows error 'Cannot generate reports for future dates' or returns empty.

Test Steps: Verify Admin can create a custom report
Test Data: 1. Go to Custom Reports 2. Select Columns: Name, Department, Joining Date 3. Apply Filters: Active Employees 4. Generate
Date of execution: Report is generated containing strictly the selected columns and filters.

Test Steps: Verify validation when no columns are selected in Custom Report
Test Data: 1. Open Custom Report Builder 2. Uncheck all columns 3. Click Generate
Date of execution: System blocks generation and prompts 'Please select at least one column'.

Test Steps: Verify Admin can export a generated report to CSV
Test Data: 1. Generate any report 2. Click 'Export to CSV'
Date of execution: A CSV file containing accurate tabular data is downloaded.

Test Steps: Verify Admin can export a generated report to PDF
Test Data: 1. Generate any report 2. Click 'Export to PDF'
Date of execution: A well-formatted PDF file with company logo and headers is downloaded.

Test Steps: Verify validation when attempting to export an empty report
Test Data: 1. Generate a report that yields '0 Records Found' 2. Click Export
Date of execution: System disables export button or shows 'No data available to export' error.

Test Steps: Verify exported data perfectly matches UI data
Test Data: 1. Generate report and check total row count 2. Export to CSV 3. Count rows in CSV
Date of execution: Row counts, totals, and column names in CSV exactly match the web view.

Test Steps: Verify Admin can schedule a report delivery
Test Data: 1. Go to Report Scheduler 2. Select 'Weekly Headcount' 3. Set interval to 'Every Monday' 4. Add email 5. Save
Date of execution: Schedule is saved, and backend cron job sends email to the specified address.

Test Steps: Verify validation when scheduling report with invalid email
Test Data: 1. Create Schedule 2. Enter email as 'admin_company.com' 3. Save
Date of execution: System rejects input and asks for a valid email format.

Test Data: 1. Go to Main Dashboard 2. Check Employee Headcount Pie Chart and Attrition Bar Chart
Date of execution: Charts render properly using current DB data without UI overlap/distortion.

Test Steps: Verify Dashboard Charts are clickable and route to detailed reports
Test Data: 1. Click on the 'IT Department' slice in Headcount Pie Chart
Date of execution: System redirects to Employee Directory filtered by IT Department.

Test Steps: Verify Manager role access restrictions on Reports
Test Data: 1. Log in as Manager 2. Go to Reports 3. Generate 'Department Headcount'
Date of execution: Manager can only see data belonging to their own department/reportees.

Test Steps: Verify Manager cannot view highly sensitive Financial Reports
Test Data: 1. Log in as Manager 2. Search for 'Company Profit/Payroll Summary' reports
Date of execution: Sensitive reports are hidden from the Manager's view based on permissions.

Test Steps: Verify Regular Employee cannot access the Reports module
Test Data: 1. Log in as Staff/Employee 2. Attempt to navigate to /hrms/reports
Date of execution: System redirects to dashboard with '403 Forbidden' access denied message.

Test Steps: Verify system handles large dataset report generation
Test Data: 1. Generate 'All Employee Attendance for Last 5 Years' (if DB has large records) 2. Measure time
Date of execution: System should handle query efficiently, paginate results, or warn if query is too large (avoiding crash).

Test Steps: Verify system times out gracefully on extremely heavy queries
Test Data: 1. Submit an intentionally massive/complex custom report query 2. Wait
Executed By: system aborts and shows 'Request timeout' instead of hanging indefinitely.
